So RIGHT can only extend the track to col 38, not all the way to the colored blocks. This means the game mechanic is different from what I thought.
Let me reconsider:
- UP/DOWN: moves the avatar vertically
- RIGHT: extends the track to the right (up to a limit)
- LEFT: probably retracts the track
- ACTION7: seems to do something with the background/room
- MOUSE: not tried yet
Maybe the goal isn't to physically reach the colored blocks with the track. Maybe it's about:
1. Aligning the avatar with each colored block
2. Using ACTION7 to "paint" or "collect" the color
3. Repeating for all colors in the order shown in the HUD
Or maybe I need to use MOUSE to click on the colored blocks directly.
Let me try a completely different approach. Let me use MOUSE to click on one of the colored blocks and see what happens.
